configuration.name: journal
configuration.description: `storageLogStore(host, id, { prefix })` 仅从 `@migaia/storage-host/journal` 导出。传入真实宿主或固定组织视图及其已安装后端 ID；它不接受 public KV、raw store 或伪造宿主。后端必须提供原私有 journal binding，以及可靠独占或同操作原子读改写；打开先完成恢复。独占缓存路径同组织与 prefix 只允许一个日志句柄；非独占路径允许多个句柄，由每次原生事务读取当前状态。不同组织相互隔离。句柄由原宿主登记接管，调用方也可提前释放。显式日志关闭排空已入 FIFO 的工作；宿主关闭保留原 pipeline 准入，尚未进入后端的工作可能以原 HOST_DISPOSING cause 拒绝，全部已接纳 Promise 仍排空；业务枚举、clear 与容量不触及私有日志。

symbols.purpose: The single augmentable event map shared by host construction, stage adapters and hooks.on; observers cannot veto storage.
symbols.core:
onEvict: Committed native eviction count for one channel; emitted after actual commit.
beforeHostInstall: Original initial or later install batch is about to run.
afterHostInstall: The original plugin tuple committed and became published.
onHostInstallError: The original install batch failed; payload contains its semantic failure code.
beforeBackendPluginInstall: Observe exact backend identity before its original plugin installation.
afterBackendPluginInstall: Original backend plugin preparation completed successfully.
onBackendPluginInstallError: Original backend plugin installation failed with a normalized code.
beforeHostClose: Original close begins with the current registered backend count.
afterHostClose: Original host cleanup finished; the lifecycle remains terminal.
onHostCloseError: Original host cleanup collected failures; observer only reports its code.
beforeEnvelopeCheck: Known target version before the original archive validation.
afterEnvelopeCheck: Archive validation succeeded and the stored version is now known.
onVersionRejected: The original archive version check rejected the supplied data.
beforeMigrationStep: Original ordered migration step is about to receive its input.
afterMigrationStep: Original migration step completed successfully.
afterMigrate: Original migration plan or reset completed with its actual elapsed time.
beforeEncode: Original codec is about to encode the proposed value.
afterEncode: Original codec encoding completed successfully.
onEncodeError: Original codec encoding failed with its normalized semantic code.
beforeDecode: Original codec is about to decode persisted input.
afterDecode: Original codec decoding completed successfully.
onDecodeError: Original codec decoding failed with its normalized code.
beforeQuery: Original query plan has been prepared before its native cursor opens.
afterQuery: Original query completed with actual result and execution counts.
onQueryError: Original query failed; observation reports its semantic code.
beforeTransaction: Before the original native transaction is created.
onTransactionStart: Original native transaction has been registered with its authentic id.
beforeTxOperation: Before one already-admitted authentic transaction operation.
afterTxOperation: After one original transaction operation settles.
beforeCommit: Original final-check boundary immediately before native commit.
afterCommit: Original native owner confirmed commit and actual changed-key count.
afterRollback: Original native rollback completed with its primary failure retained.
onTransactionClose: Original native transaction resource reached its actual end.
beforePersistFlush: Before the original transactional persistence flush.
afterPersistFlush: Encoding and native requests completed; this alone is not a commit certificate.
beforeBackendCreate: Before original native backend construction acquires resources.
afterBackendCreate: Original backend construction returned its actual native object.
onBackendRejected: Original runtime backend admission rejected its candidate.
afterBackendInstall: Original backend and its selected capabilities were installed.
onBackendDisposeStart: Original backend cleanup started after admission was sealed.
afterBackendDispose: Original backend cleanup reached its terminal boundary.
beforeSql: Before the actual native SQL request; only statement bytes and parameter count are observed.
afterSql: After actual native SQL execution with elapsed time and affected rows.
onSqlError: Actual native SQL execution failed; only the normalized code is exposed.
beforeStorageOperation: Before the original public endpoint’s actual work.
afterStorageOperation: The original endpoint settled successfully with actual count and elapsed time.
onStorageOperationError: Original endpoint failed and retained its primary failure.
onStorageIterationClose: Original storage iterator closed with its actual consumed-row count.
beforeLockAcquire: Original policy is selected before canonical lock admission.

onEvict: Committed native eviction count for one channel; emitted after actual commit.
beforeHostInstall: Original initial or later install batch is about to run.
afterHostInstall: The original plugin tuple committed and became published.
onHostInstallError: The original install batch failed; payload contains its semantic failure code.
beforeBackendPluginInstall: Observe exact backend identity before its original plugin installation.
afterBackendPluginInstall: Original backend plugin preparation completed successfully.
onBackendPluginInstallError: Original backend plugin installation failed with a normalized code.
beforeHostClose: Original close begins with the current registered backend count.
afterHostClose: Original host cleanup finished; the lifecycle remains terminal.
onHostCloseError: Original host cleanup collected failures; observer only reports its code.
beforeEnvelopeCheck: Known target version before the original archive validation.
afterEnvelopeCheck: Archive validation succeeded and the stored version is now known.
onVersionRejected: The original archive version check rejected the supplied data.
beforeMigrationStep: Original ordered migration step is about to receive its input.
afterMigrationStep: Original migration step completed successfully.
afterMigrate: Original migration plan or reset completed with its actual elapsed time.
beforeEncode: Original codec is about to encode the proposed value.
afterEncode: Original codec encoding completed successfully.
onEncodeError: Original codec encoding failed with its normalized semantic code.
beforeDecode: Original codec is about to decode persisted input.
afterDecode: Original codec decoding completed successfully.
onDecodeError: Original codec decoding failed with its normalized code.
beforeQuery: Original query plan has been prepared before its native cursor opens.
afterQuery: Original query completed with actual result and execution counts.
onQueryError: Original query failed; observation reports its semantic code.
beforeTransaction: Before the original native transaction is created.

beforeTxOperation: Before one already-admitted authentic transaction operation.
afterTxOperation: After one original transaction operation settles.

afterCommit: Original native owner confirmed commit and actual changed-key count.
afterRollback: Original native rollback completed with its primary failure retained.
onTransactionClose: Original native transaction resource reached its actual end.
beforePersistFlush: Before the original transactional persistence flush.
afterPersistFlush: Encoding and native requests completed; this alone is not a commit certificate.

afterBackendCreate: Original backend construction returned its actual native object.
onBackendRejected: Original runtime backend admission rejected its candidate.
afterBackendInstall: Original backend and its selected capabilities were installed.
onBackendDisposeStart: Original backend cleanup started after admission was sealed.
afterBackendDispose: Original backend cleanup reached its terminal boundary.
beforeSql: Before the actual native SQL request; only statement bytes and parameter count are observed.
afterSql: After actual native SQL execution with elapsed time and affected rows.
onSqlError: Actual native SQL execution failed; only the normalized code is exposed.
beforeStorageOperation: Before the original public endpoint’s actual work.
afterStorageOperation: The original endpoint settled successfully with actual count and elapsed time.
onStorageOperationError: Original endpoint failed and retained its primary failure.
onStorageIterationClose: Original storage iterator closed with its actual consumed-row count.
beforeLockAcquire: Original policy is selected before canonical lock admission.
onLockAcquired: Original owner acquired the actual canonical locks for this attempt.
onLockConflict: Actual acquisition or commit conflict with its original holder facts.
onLockWait: Original attempt waited on the existing admission owner.
onConcurrencyDecision: Original policy returned its authentic next decision.

onLockInspectError: Original lock inspection failed with its coded error.
beforeLogOpen: Original logger store or durable resource is about to open.
afterLogOpen: Original durable log resource opened successfully.
onLogOpenError: Original durable log opening failed.
beforeLogOperation: Before the original durable log operation.
afterLogOperation: Original durable log operation completed.
onLogOperationError: Original durable log operation failed.
beforeLogClose: Original durable log resource begins cleanup.
afterLogClose: Original durable log cleanup finished.
onLogCloseError: Original durable log resource cleanup failed.
onAppend: Original logger append published committed records.
onWalPending: Original WAL owner observed its actual pending record.
onBinlogAppendError: External commit-only publication failed after an actual business commit.
beforeJournalRecover: Before matching-target original journal recovery.
afterJournalRecover: Original matching-target recovery completed with actual count and duration.
onJournalRecoverError: Original matching-target recovery failed.
beforeDetect: Before the original installed backend environment checks.
afterDetect: Original detection completed with actual check count and elapsed time.
onDetectError: Original environment detection failed with its semantic code.

symbols.purpose: The exact installed plugin tuple’s original registry, business access, hooks and root lifecycle.
symbols.core:
hooks: The original typed synchronous observer registry; failures only report.
extensions: Frozen installed plugin extensions; explicitly contextual methods use this fixed organization.
api: Per-backend selected Feature API, preserving original client and authentic transaction projection.
detect: Run only the registered original backend checks and await their cleanup.
Completes detection or rejects its original coded failure.
org: Return a new immutable business view under this root lifecycle, retaining exact plugin inference.
org.orgId: Caller-created canonical UUID, normally returned by createOrgId.
A fixed-org view with no installation, deletion or disposal authority.
dropOrg: Attempt every admitted backend target for this organization without closing existing business views.
dropOrg.orgId: Canonical UUID returned by createOrgId or an existing org view.
Completes all deletions; failures aggregate original errors and successful targets are not rolled back.
use: Atomically install one readonly tuple through the original PluginHost batch and rollback failed preparation.
use.plugins: Original handles returned by definePlugin or native backend plugin factories.

backend: Look up the exact original admitted backend by its installed literal id.
backend.id: Literal id returned on the originally installed plugin handle.

hasBackend: Check original published membership without preparing or opening a backend.
hasBackend.id: Candidate id chosen by the caller from installed plugin ids.

backends: Return the current readonly membership snapshot with exact admitted backend values.

dispose: Seal the original host, drain accepted work and release installed resources in their existing order.

sections.title: 介绍

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
hooks: The original typed synchronous observer registry; failures only report.
extensions: Frozen installed plugin extensions; explicitly contextual methods use this fixed organization.
api: Per-backend selected Feature API, preserving original client and authentic transaction projection.
detect: Run only the registered original backend checks and await their cleanup.
Completes detection or rejects its original coded failure.
org: Return a new immutable business view under this root lifecycle, retaining exact plugin inference.
org.orgId: Caller-created canonical UUID, normally returned by createOrgId.
A fixed-org view with no installation, deletion or disposal authority.
dropOrg: Attempt every admitted backend target for this organization without closing existing business views.
dropOrg.orgId: Canonical UUID returned by createOrgId or an existing org view.
Completes all deletions; failures aggregate original errors and successful targets are not rolled back.
use: Atomically install one readonly tuple through the original PluginHost batch and rollback failed preparation.
use.plugins: Original handles returned by definePlugin or native backend plugin factories.
The same runtime host with the widened installed tuple; await detect after later native installation. Duplicate or overlapping batches reject.
backend: Look up the exact original admitted backend by its installed literal id.
backend.id: Literal id returned on the originally installed plugin handle.
Exact native store with selected Features; org views return a close-free fixed-org borrow.
hasBackend: Check original published membership without preparing or opening a backend.
hasBackend.id: Candidate id chosen by the caller from installed plugin ids.
True narrows the id to this host’s published registry keys.
backends: Return the current readonly membership snapshot with exact admitted backend values.
Readonly map; org views project each value into the same fixed organization.
dispose: Seal the original host, drain accepted work and release installed resources in their existing order.
The original cached cleanup Promise; all failures remain inspectable through causes or aggregate errors.
codecStages: Bind report-only codec encoding and decoding to this exact store registration.
codecStages.store: Exact backend returned by this host, or its authenticated fixed-org borrow.
Original observer methods; they allocate no backend, transaction or diagnostic queue.
queryStages: Bind report-only query planning and completion to this exact store registration.
queryStages.store: Exact backend returned by this host, or its authenticated fixed-org borrow.
transactionStages: Bind report-only native transaction boundaries to this exact store registration.
transactionStages.store: Exact backend returned by this host, or its authenticated fixed-org borrow.
concurrencyStages: Bind report-only original concurrency decisions to this exact store registration.
concurrencyStages.store: Exact backend returned by this host, or its authenticated fixed-org borrow.
backendStages: Bind report-only original backend creation and disposal to this exact store registration.
backendStages.store: Exact backend returned by this host, or its authenticated fixed-org borrow.
sqlStages: Bind report-only original native SQL request observations to this exact store registration.
sqlStages.store: Exact backend returned by this host, or its authenticated fixed-org borrow.
operationStages: Bind report-only original storage endpoint observations to this exact store registration.
operationStages.store: Exact backend returned by this host, or its authenticated fixed-org borrow.
envelopeStages: Bind report-only archive validation/migration stages to one exact store and operation.
envelopeStages.store: Exact admitted store or authenticated business borrow returned by this host.
envelopeStages.operation: Original repository operation name and target version.
Original envelope observers retaining only primitive operation context.

symbols.purpose: One captured fixed-org borrowed logger configuration; selected commit recording uses the original asynchronous bootstrap stage.
symbols.core:
logger: Original Logger with actual selected durable/level plugins; storage borrows it and never shuts it down.
namespace: Caller-selected nonempty stable recovery namespace, combined with exact backend and org identity.
binlogValues: Optional true adds committed encoded values to binlog entries; omission omits those values. WAL always retains full images.
atomicBinlog: Explicit backend-id map of exact storageLogStore objects from the same registration for native log/data composition.
indexedDbUndo: Explicit true opts into the IndexedDB original undo combination; omission does not grant that capability.
atomicUndo: Exact same-registration private undo carriers selected by backend id; unrelated matching ids cannot replace them.
telemetry: Optional true requires the actual level plugin and emits ordinary storage-category entries with original payload/Error references.
redoWal: The exact shared latest-pending WAL object used by every text redo participant; same names or independent cached writers do not prove sharing.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.

import { blob } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { createStorageHost, memoryBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-host'

await using host = await createStorageHost({ plugins: [memoryBackendPlugin()] })
const objects = host.backend('memory').use(blob)
await objects.put('images/sample', new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]), { ifNoneMatch: true })
await using object = (await objects.get('images/sample', { range: { start: 1, end: 1 } }))!
console.log((await object.bytes())[0]) // 2

import { records } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { createStorageHost, memoryBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-host'

await using host = await createStorageHost({ plugins: [memoryBackendPlugin()] })
const store = host.backend('memory')
await store.putRecord({ active: true }, 'one')
console.log(
  await store
    .use(records)
    .query<{ active: boolean }>()
    .where({ active: true })
    .update({ active: false })
) // 1

import { createStorageHost, memoryBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { storageLogStore } from '@migaia/storage-host/journal'
import { LogRecordState } from '@migaia/logger/plugins/durable'

await using host = await createStorageHost({ plugins: [memoryBackendPlugin()] })
await using log = await storageLogStore(host, 'memory', { prefix: 'history' })
await log.append([{ kind: 'order.created', payload: { id: 'o1' } }])
await log.setState(1, LogRecordState.done)
console.log(await log.lastSeq(), await log.states(LogRecordState.pending)) // 1 []

sections.content: Define an isolated memory backend without acquiring data before installation. Optional namespace-local capacity captures positive maxEntries/maxBytes and lru (default) or lfu once. Linked policy nodes and the original deadline radix select committed victims; native transactions and root writes share the original owner, budget and victim locks. onEvict reports only per-channel counts after commit. configuration.name: capacity
configuration.description: 可选 `capacity: { maxEntries?, maxBytes?, eviction? }` 按原生 namespace 限制公开物理条目；省略容量保持无上限。两个上限须为正安全整数，`eviction` 为 `lru`（缺省）或 `lfu`，创建插件时单次捕获，非法项在分配原生状态前报 `INVALID_ARGUMENT`。LRU 与 LFU 以双向节点和频次桶维护，不扫描历史；LFU 写入也记一次命中，新增低频项可能成为自身淘汰目标。命中读更新策略，过期项通过原 deadline 与压缩 radix 索引先惰性回收，再选择容量目标，无 timer。事务和批量驱逐只随原 draft 提交；等待或回滚不先删数据，忙目标沿原锁预算等待或拒绝。`onEvict` 每个受影响通道只发一次 `{ backendId, backend, orgId, count, channel }`，普通删除、过期不发，监听失败仅报告。

configuration.name: owner
configuration.description: 原生连接只通过 `featureExpose` 暴露惰性函数。它只接收自有、可枚举、字符串键的函数属性，包括 `getClient`。事务后端通过原事务 owner 提供 `getTransactionClient(scope)`。`getKind/getStore/getBackendId/getLifecycle/onDispose/getScheduler` 由宿主保留，作者不能覆盖。

configuration.name: owner.label
configuration.description: `memoryBackendPlugin()` 与 `memoryBackendKind` 由宿主根入口提供。每次安装拥有独立内存数据，即使 namespace 相同也不共享。文本、字节、记录事务复用原事务 owner、并发策略和本地锁；`scope.use(kv)` 提供同事务的八个文本方法，`scope.use(records)` 使用同一实际记录游标执行查询。配置的 owner.label 捕获后保持稳定；没有标签时使用运行时与 pid，浏览器使用 browser。原生 client getter 返回 undefined，事务 client 校验原 scope 后返回 undefined。 所选 Feature 记录独立放在最后一个参数：`memoryBackendPlugin(options, features)`；省略 options 可传 undefined，缺省 id 仍为 memory。

backendNotInstalled: Install this exact id or select a currently installed backend.

backendKindMismatch: Use the authentic backend kind selected by this installed store.
invalidConfig: Repair malformed schema, codec or author configuration.
validationFailed: Inspect the original schema rejection before changing the proposed value.
serializeFailed: Encoding rejected before backend I/O; inspect the original codec cause.
deserializeFailed: Preserve stored bytes and inspect the original decoding failure.
duplicateKey: Another channel owns the key; explicit replace removes that owner.
indexUniqueConflict: Another record owns the projected unique value; repair the proposed commit.
indexBackfillFailed: Backfill and failed-readiness persistence both failed; inspect every cause.
migrationFailed: Correct the original application migration failure before retrying.
versionUnsupported: Stored data is newer than this definition; use a compatible entity version.
transactionFailed: Inspect the original memory native transaction failure.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Canonical host messages and parameterized text factories; applications branch on semantic codes rather than these diagnostic strings. The vectorMmr entry diagnoses invalid MMR lambda, topN or hit vectors from the independent scorer.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import StorageErrorText from @migaia/storage-host, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use StorageErrorText when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when StorageErrorText does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

symbols.purpose: Construct the original lifecycle shell synchronously; createStorageHost is the asynchronous initial-install and detection entry.
symbols.core:
options: Captured original host lifecycle options; plugins are installed separately with use.
The original host facade, owned and closed by its caller.
hooks: The original typed synchronous observer registry; failures only report.
extensions: Frozen installed plugin extensions; explicitly contextual methods use this fixed organization.
api: Per-backend selected Feature API, preserving original client and authentic transaction projection.
detect: Run only the registered original backend checks and await their cleanup.
Completes detection or rejects its original coded failure.
org: Return a new immutable business view under this root lifecycle, retaining exact plugin inference.
org.orgId: Caller-created canonical UUID, normally returned by createOrgId.
A fixed-org view with no installation, deletion or disposal authority.
dropOrg: Attempt every admitted backend target for this organization without closing existing business views.
dropOrg.orgId: Canonical UUID returned by createOrgId or an existing org view.
Completes all deletions; failures aggregate original errors and successful targets are not rolled back.
use: Atomically install one readonly tuple through the original PluginHost batch and rollback failed preparation.
use.plugins: Original handles returned by definePlugin or native backend plugin factories.
The same runtime host with the widened installed tuple; await detect after later native installation. Duplicate or overlapping batches reject.
backend: Look up the exact original admitted backend by its installed literal id.
backend.id: Literal id returned on the originally installed plugin handle.
Exact native store with selected Features; org views return a close-free fixed-org borrow.
hasBackend: Check original published membership without preparing or opening a backend.
hasBackend.id: Candidate id chosen by the caller from installed plugin ids.
True narrows the id to this host’s published registry keys.
backends: Return the current readonly membership snapshot with exact admitted backend values.
Readonly map; org views project each value into the same fixed organization.
dispose: Seal the original host, drain accepted work and release installed resources in their existing order.
The original cached cleanup Promise; all failures remain inspectable through causes or aggregate errors.
codecStages: Bind report-only codec encoding and decoding to this exact store registration.
codecStages.store: Exact backend returned by this host, or its authenticated fixed-org borrow.
Original observer methods; they allocate no backend, transaction or diagnostic queue.
queryStages: Bind report-only query planning and completion to this exact store registration.
queryStages.store: Exact backend returned by this host, or its authenticated fixed-org borrow.
transactionStages: Bind report-only native transaction boundaries to this exact store registration.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Construct the original lifecycle shell synchronously; createStorageHost is the asynchronous initial-install and detection entry.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import StorageHostFacade from @migaia/storage-host, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use StorageHostFacade when its class contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when StorageHostFacade does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained class example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
options: Captured original host lifecycle options; plugins are installed separately with use.
The original host facade, owned and closed by its caller.
hooks: The original typed synchronous observer registry; failures only report.
extensions: Frozen installed plugin extensions; explicitly contextual methods use this fixed organization.
api: Per-backend selected Feature API, preserving original client and authentic transaction projection.
detect: Run only the registered original backend checks and await their cleanup.
Completes detection or rejects its original coded failure.
org: Return a new immutable business view under this root lifecycle, retaining exact plugin inference.
org.orgId: Caller-created canonical UUID, normally returned by createOrgId.
A fixed-org view with no installation, deletion or disposal authority.
dropOrg: Attempt every admitted backend target for this organization without closing existing business views.
dropOrg.orgId: Canonical UUID returned by createOrgId or an existing org view.
Completes all deletions; failures aggregate original errors and successful targets are not rolled back.
use: Atomically install one readonly tuple through the original PluginHost batch and rollback failed preparation.
use.plugins: Original handles returned by definePlugin or native backend plugin factories.
The same runtime host with the widened installed tuple; await detect after later native installation. Duplicate or overlapping batches reject.
backend: Look up the exact original admitted backend by its installed literal id.
backend.id: Literal id returned on the originally installed plugin handle.
Exact native store with selected Features; org views return a close-free fixed-org borrow.
hasBackend: Check original published membership without preparing or opening a backend.
hasBackend.id: Candidate id chosen by the caller from installed plugin ids.
True narrows the id to this host’s published registry keys.
backends: Return the current readonly membership snapshot with exact admitted backend values.
Readonly map; org views project each value into the same fixed organization.
dispose: Seal the original host, drain accepted work and release installed resources in their existing order.
The original cached cleanup Promise; all failures remain inspectable through causes or aggregate errors.

configuration.name: autoDetect
configuration.description: 环境检查通过 `core.registerDetect(check)` 或 Feature 注入的同名函数登记，只能在原安装窗口调用。检查按插件安装顺序和登记顺序执行，使用原 registration 的取消信号。`createStorageHost` 默认在返回前完成检查；失败保留原错误并逆序释放已构造资源。设置 `autoDetect: false` 可延迟到显式 `await host.detect()`：未完成时，真实执行终点在业务 I/O 前拒绝 contract `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`，不会隐式调用检查。并发 `detect()` 返回同一个 Promise，成功缓存，失败可重试；新增插件批次需要再显式检查新增登记。关闭沿原资源 scope 排空已经开始的检查。

configuration.name: scheduler
configuration.description: `observeStorageBatch(stages, scheduler, operation, count, invoke)` 复用同一份批量操作观察算法。作者先用原 store/scope 完成准入，再传入真实 operation stages 与宿主 scheduler；助手只调用一次原工作，发出一次 before/after 或 before/error，计时包含原 pipeline 与 native 终结。before/error 的 count 为输入条目数，after 对数字结果使用实际计数，其余结果使用输入条目数；异常对象原样拒绝。助手不拥有 pipeline、事务或关闭权，空批由调用方在准入后直接返回。

configuration.name: report
configuration.description: 未选 `atomicBinlog[id]` 的 memory backend 使用外置 binlog：仅在原生 COMMIT 后追加，原操作等该追加结算；失败通过宿主原 `report` 和 `onBinlogAppendError` 元数据观察事件报告，已提交数据和成功结果不回滚，后续写入仍可继续。回滚与空写不追加。仅当未选 WAL、undo、atomicBinlog 和 atomicUndo 时，纯外置 binlog 可借用 nativeAtomic:false 的真实成功 terminal；其原 fact 不变，仍由原 onCommit 决定追加，凡涉及其它日志保证均要求原 nativeAtomic:true。后端作者的 `IStorageJournalAttempt.settle?()` 只用于排空原 terminal 已启动的外置工作；同原生追加路径不增加该等待。外置 WAL 使用下述原 intent/marker 协议。

configuration.name: channel
configuration.description: `probe(identities, ranges?, current?)` 从同一原锁表直接探测规范身份，返回首个脱离的 `ILockHolding` 或 undefined；单键最多进行固定三个通道的 Map.get，范围只扫描所选通道的活锁。范围项为 `{channel,lower,upper}`，边界来自 contract 的 `snapshotConcurrencyLockRange`。`attemptWrite(ctx,holder,write,stages?,admissionSignal?,ranges?,admit?)` 复用同一尝试与 FIFO，write 必须是同步原生修改；最终锁检查与 write 在同一同步执行段。optimistic 根写不创建持锁行，仍尊重已有悲观锁。等待或观察回调之后必须重新检查，排除本尝试已持有的 lease；不创建范围锁。可选 current 必须是原活跃 attempt context，只跳过其实际持有的同一 lease，继续查找其它 holder；声明键或相同 owner 文本不授予豁免。可选 admit(commit) 接后端已有物理准入：先逻辑键、再物理门，commit 至多一次且最终重查操作与成员 signal；原 lease 等物理清理真实结算后释放。

configuration.name: key
configuration.description: `core.registerValueCommit(store, commit)` 只在原安装窗口接纳已交接的同一 store。`/authoring/backend` 的 `IBackendValueCommit` 接收固定 `{prefix,expected,key,value}` 与可选写上下文；expected 是原始字符串键值快照。实体在异步 schema/codec/投影准备完成后借用该终点，原生后端在原物理准入内同步复核与写入，期间没有 await。它与 controller、envelope 观察共享同一内部 row，卸载由原 scope 清理；登记权与关闭权不向实体开放。 同一个 frozen/raw store 被多个宿主接纳时，envelope 边界向其仍登记的原宿主观察者扇出；释放只移除所属绑定，单宿主保持原观察接点。

configuration.description: 后端 core 的 `createKeyLockPort()` 只在原安装窗口构造共享本地键锁端口；`/authoring/backend` 仅导出其 `IBackendKeyLockPort` 类型。`attempt(ctx, holder, native, stages?, admissionSignal?, ranges?)` 消费 contract 原规范身份和尝试序号：先 try，只有 wait 决策进入原 utils FIFO，锁持续到 native attempt 真正提交、回滚和清理结束。`inspectLocks()` 返回按规范顺序排列的脱离快照。物理后端的原闭包持有端口并在最后一个引用释放时清理；共享端口不随首次创建它的插件自动关闭。端口释放先停止接纳并真正排空，主清理与 symbol 各保留缓存 Promise。 可选 ranges 为异步根写启用同一 FIFO 的点和范围保护（空数组仅保护点）；optimistic 仍等待已有悲观 holder，未传时保留原事务行为。

symbols.name: createBackendJournalNamespace
symbols.signature: export declare function createBackendJournalNamespace(options: IBackendJournalNamespaceOptions): Promise<IStorageJournalNamespace>;
symbols.purpose: Reuse the original private namespace resource lifetime; backend owners retain data and actual native terminal decisions.
symbols.core:
options: Original assertLive/closingSignal/report, native facts, reservation, authenticated private transaction and native transaction entry.
Promise of IStorageJournalNamespace. run and terminal subscriptions retain accepted work until actual onEnd; transactionInfo is a pure authenticated fact. No raw client, installer or backend close rights.
assertLive: Synchronous original backend admission check; a throw prevents namespace construction or subsequent private work.
Normal return permits work; the original coded admission error is thrown synchronously.
Keep namespace access within the native backend admission boundary.
closingSignal: Original backend closure signal initiating namespace release while accepted native work drains.
report: Receives asynchronous cleanup failures from closure or symbolic disposal without replacing a primary result.
report.error: Original asynchronous cleanup cause supplied by the namespace resource owner.
The original diagnostic observer receives the failure; no native retry or replacement commit is started.
Preserve cleanup diagnostics separately from an original primary transaction failure.
backend: Original backend diagnostic kind attached to namespace admission and disposal errors.
undefined; errors omit a backend-specific diagnostic value.
nativeAtomic: Backend fact about all-or-nothing native transaction semantics; resource reservation alone cannot grant atomic rollback.
The original native transaction supplies all-or-nothing mutation and rollback.
The native owner does not guarantee all-or-nothing rollback; WAL, undo and atomic-store combinations stay unsupported.
Declare the existing native guarantee accurately before selecting atomic journal combinations.
indexExclusive: Explicit false means logger indexes must reload from the native transaction each operation; it does not weaken or strengthen nativeAtomic.
Omitted retains the exclusive namespace index contract of the original backend.
Restore the current logger index inside each original native transaction; never retain it across operations.
Use false when independent handles share the physical namespace and no lifetime-exclusive index can be retained.
reserve: Original physical owner invokes hold after reservation is acquired and awaits it until release; acquisition rejection rejects namespace creation.
reserve.hold: Async callback invoked once the original reservation is acquired; its settlement releases that reservation.
Original reservation Promise, rejecting on native acquisition or retained-work failure.
Connect the private namespace lifetime to the existing physical owner reservation.
authenticate: Synchronously validate the exact live original scope and return its existing transaction identity and private journal port; foreign scopes reject.
authenticate.scope: Exact backend-issued original live transaction scope, without capability lookup authority.
The original transaction info and journal port; foreign or expired scopes throw before private I/O.
Borrow journal work from an already admitted authentic native transaction.
transaction: Run the callback on the original newly admitted native transaction port and settle only after the native owner settles; never create a second commit owner.
transaction.work: Async callback receiving the original native journal transaction port; callback rejection stays with its native owner.
Callback value only after original native transaction settlement; unknown outcomes remain failures.
Start one original native transaction when no caller transaction scope is supplied.
symbols.returns: Promise<IStorageJournalNamespace>

configuration.name: report
configuration.description: 未选 `atomicBinlog[id]` 的 memory backend 使用外置 binlog：仅在原生 COMMIT 后追加，原操作等该追加结算；失败通过宿主原 `report` 和 `onBinlogAppendError` 元数据观察事件报告，已提交数据和成功结果不回滚，后续写入仍可继续。回滚与空写不追加。仅当未选 WAL、undo、atomicBinlog 和 atomicUndo 时，纯外置 binlog 可借用 nativeAtomic:false 的真实成功 terminal；其原 fact 不变，仍由原 onCommit 决定追加，凡涉及其它日志保证均要求原 nativeAtomic:true。后端作者的 `IStorageJournalAttempt.settle?()` 只用于排空原 terminal 已启动的外置工作；同原生追加路径不增加该等待。外置 WAL 使用下述原 intent/marker 协议。

configuration.name: nativeAtomic
configuration.description: 追加先捕获原 logger JSON，再沿既有 FIFO 写入记录并最终提交唯一 head；只有真实非空 commit 才更新原 logger 索引并发布一次冻结通知。状态只从 pending 前进到 done/aborted；截断先提交水位再回收物理行，重开保留最高序号与时间，不复用序号。未确认写入使句柄停止准入，必须关闭并重开；恢复忽略未提交记录及状态候选并清理残留，原错误留在 cause。私有记录或载荷损坏统一报 `JOURNAL_RECORD_INVALID`，原 logger 校验错误仍在 cause。无原生事务的私有 namespace 仍可沿同协议工作，但必须由后端提供可靠独占与单键原子 head 写入。内置绑定覆盖 memory、SQLite、PostgreSQL、Redis 和 IndexedDB，各自保留原 nativeAtomic 事实；host 内部原生追加端口已接同一日志对象与准确组织，复用原 native scope/terminal，绕过普通日志 FIFO；同一事务并发批次分配不同序号，真实 commit 才一次发布，rollback 不发布。后端还须提供可选 `runCommitted(work, committed)`，在原 head lease 释放前将实际结果交给同步发布回调；缺此接点仅不支持该原生追加组合，普通日志照常。其 callback 是提交后观察，错误仅 report，不能假回滚。该端口不从公开 entry 导出；打开日志不自动启用全局 journal，必须由宿主 journal 选项显式选择。

declaredConfiguration.description: Requests cooperative cancellation. Backends can ignore work cancellation, while cancellation-aware operations stop waiting with the contract `ABORTED` error. Uses a structural signal without depending on the global `AbortSignal`.

declaredConfiguration.name: timeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional non-negative safe-integer timeout in milliseconds. The backend creates any timer or combined signal it needs; this contract package creates neither. Omission leaves timing to the implementation rather than supplying a default duration.

declaredConfiguration.name: pageSize
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional iterator page-size hint: an integer from 1 through 4096. No default is inserted here.

declaredConfiguration.name: orgId
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional canonical lowercase UUID supplied by an outer host. The contract preserves omission; the host chooses the default organization and owns namespace mapping.

configuration.name: schema
configuration.description: 自定义 value-only 后端的 unique 写入必须具备 record 事务或原子 value commit 接点；仅有 sync 通道不等于具备该原子终点。两者都缺少时，仅这个 unique 写入组合在修改前拒绝 `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`；普通 KV 写入仍可使用。原后端安装窗口内，先 `core.registerStore(store)`，再 `core.registerValueCommit(store, commit)`。`IBackendValueCommit` 从 `@migaia/storage-host/authoring/backend` 导出：`commit({prefix, expected, key, value}, ctx?)` 返回 `Promise<void>`；`expected` 是该前缀捕获的原始 `[key,value]` 对。异步 schema/codec 准备完成后，后端须原子复核这份前缀快照并写入 `key/value`，复核和修改之间不得有 await 缝隙；快照变化时以 `WRITE_CONFLICT` 拒绝且不修改数据。该接点只借用原 native store，不新增资源或关闭权。

configuration.name: codec
configuration.description: Schema 与 codec 适配位于 `@migaia/storage-host/entity`：`passthrough`、`fromStandardSchema`、`jsonCodec`、`structuredCodec`、`binaryCodec` 和 `selectCodec`。Codec 协议仍由 `@migaia/storage-contract` 拥有。JSON 路由名为 `json@1`，直接复用 portable JSON codec；undefined、非有限数字等不支持的值会被拒绝。编码和解码错误分别携带宿主 `SERIALIZE_FAILED`、`DESERIALIZE_FAILED`，cause 保留 contract 与原 codec 错误。Structured 和 binary 恒等 codec 保留原对象引用；文本后端可显式选择 binary 的 base64 路由。
configuration.descriptionEn: Applies on every backend through `selectCodec` using `store.capabilities`. Structured backends do not bypass an explicitly configured codec. When omitted, IndexedDB and memory default to `structuredCodec`, preserving objects through native structured cloning. Key-value-only backends default to `jsonCodec`.

configuration.name: lambda
configuration.description: `lambda` 是 [0,1] 内的有限数字；1 只按引擎相关性选择，0 在第一项后只选择多样性，目标相同保留引擎顺序。helper 的 `topN` 仅限制贪心前缀的计算，仍为全部候选返回等长有限分数，剩余项保留引擎顺序；真正截断只归 `rerank` 的 topN。缺省计算全部候选，保留 O(n) 状态，最坏 O(n²d) 时间。向量须维度一致；零向量的余弦多样性按 0 处理，同分保留引擎顺序。评分器取消继续使用原信号，不创建预算、资源或后台任务。
